title: Next 100 — hypothesis reservoir
score_description: Editorial discovery priority, not a probability of truth or proof

review_queue.review_question: Does correlated well measurement noise destroy the greedy submodularity argument?
review_queue.smallest_test: Construct a 3-well linear aquifer with correlated errors and compare all sensor subsets.
review_queue.review_gap: Literature on experimental-design submodularity for correlated groundwater observations is unaudited.

review_queue.review_question: Can an interval solver enclose wet/dry moving boundaries without becoming vacuous?
review_queue.smallest_test: Certify maximum inundation on a 1-D sloped beach under two uncertain boundary inputs.
review_queue.review_gap: Prior rigorous shallow-water enclosure and SLOSH methods need an exact comparison.

review_queue.review_question: Which reliability measure is still nontrivial under adversarial missed scheduled links?
review_queue.smallest_test: Enumerate four-node time-expanded contact graphs with one deleted transmission window.
review_queue.review_gap: Current store-and-forward guarantees and known DTN routing theorems must be checked.

review_queue.review_question: Do robust water-allocation certificates hold for nonconcave but realistic yield functions?
review_queue.smallest_test: Solve a two-field three-weather-state water allocation with piecewise response curves.
review_queue.review_gap: Need literature on robust irrigation scheduling and realistic yield model assumptions.

review_queue.review_question: Which covariance summaries suffice when calibrations share correlated reference standards?
review_queue.smallest_test: Prove or refute sufficiency of edge covariance labels in a four-node calibration DAG.
review_queue.review_gap: NIST uncertainty requirements provide context, not novelty or proof status.

review_queue.review_question: Can compact dual certificates survive integer boarding and accessibility constraints?
review_queue.smallest_test: Encode a 5-node road-rail-foot evacuation and compare LP gap with integer optimum.
review_queue.review_gap: Existing time-expanded evacuation models and integrality gaps remain unaudited.

review_queue.review_question: Which rate assumptions allow safely pruning kinetically irrelevant reaction paths?
review_queue.smallest_test: Exhaust a five-species reversible mass-action network with competing paths.
review_queue.review_gap: Review pathway-reduction theorems and prior numerical microkinetic models; background is not evidence of novelty.

review_queue.review_question: Can a nonvacuous finite-sample risk certificate be computed from bounded drift?
review_queue.smallest_test: Prove coverage for binary classification under a two-point covariate shift family.
review_queue.review_gap: Compare distributional robustness and PAC-Bayes guarantees before claiming novelty.

review_queue.review_question: What is the weakest independently checkable witness for constrained predictive outputs?
review_queue.smallest_test: Construct and replay certificates for bounded integer constraint inference.
review_queue.review_gap: Check certifying algorithms and formally verified inference literature.

review_queue.review_question: Is there a strict information-rate gap between acting and reconstructing observations?
review_queue.smallest_test: Solve a binary-state action problem under 0-1 task loss and Hamming distortion.
review_queue.review_gap: Rate-distortion-for-control and information bottleneck prior art must be distinguished.

review_queue.review_question: Can bounded-latency codes improve a risk-weighted objective at equal length?
review_queue.smallest_test: Enumerate binary length-six linear codes for two packet importance classes.
review_queue.review_gap: Known unequal error protection codes and operational priority semantics are unreviewed.

review_queue.review_question: When do voltage and impedance jointly identify hidden battery side-reaction rates?
review_queue.smallest_test: Calculate symbolic Jacobian ranks for a two-reaction battery equivalent circuit.
review_queue.review_gap: Review electrode-level EIS identifiability studies and battery aging parameter ambiguities.

candidates.title: Generalization under shift certificates

candidates.title: Proof-carrying inference

candidates.statement: A mastery criterion can be chosen to bound both subgroup false-mastery disparity and individual rescore instability under a stated measurement error model
candidates.consequence: Would make pass-fail thresholds more transparent about uncertainty
candidates.first_attack: Map feasible error tradeoffs on two-group Gaussian score models

candidates.title: Group learning spillover separation
candidates.statement: For a networked classroom intervention, an exposure-mapping design can distinguish peer-learning spillovers from direct instruction effects under specified randomized seating patterns
candidates.consequence: Would prevent incorrect attribution of group learning gains
candidates.first_attack: Study finite network randomized exposure estimands

candidates.title: Proof-to-program compression
candidates.statement: Every theorem in a restricted bounded-arithmetic fragment has a proof-producing algorithm whose overhead is polynomial in the shortest proof
candidates.consequence: Could convert more mathematical proofs into practical certifying algorithms
candidates.first_attack: Choose a fragment and seek proof-length lower bounds

candidates.title: Streaming compression with reversible updates
candidates.statement: For piecewise-stationary finite alphabet sources with a fixed change budget, an online code can approach oracle segment-wise description length while retaining independently checkable decoding state
candidates.consequence: Would make changing data streams compressible without opaque adaptive behavior
candidates.first_attack: Derive regret against switch-aware compressor and find adversarial sequences

candidates.title: Semantic redundancy in scientific datasets
candidates.statement: In a finite family of scientific inference tasks, one can construct a dataset summary whose minimal length is controlled by task distinguishability rather than raw sample size
candidates.consequence: Would enable compact archives with explicit scientific limits
candidates.first_attack: Define task loss and derive sufficient-statistic counterexamples

candidates.title: Robust rate-distortion under model mismatch
candidates.statement: For a bounded uncertainty set of source distributions, a single variable-length code attains a provable competitive factor to distribution-aware rate-distortion optima
candidates.consequence: Would expose the price of compression under uncertain data models
candidates.first_attack: Compare worst-case rates on two-source mixtures

candidates.title: Error detection across mixed analog-digital links
candidates.statement: A bounded-complexity joint source-channel scheme retains an explicit false-acceptance bound for sensor messages crossing analog and digital relay stages
candidates.consequence: Would quantify data integrity across heterogeneous links
candidates.first_attack: Choose scalar quantizer and packet corruption model

candidates.title: Coded caches with uneven demand
candidates.statement: For a specified stochastic request model, asymmetric coded caching yields a provably smaller peak backhaul requirement than demand-agnostic placement at equal cache capacity
candidates.consequence: Would clarify when demand heterogeneity deserves coded infrastructure
candidates.first_attack: Compute exact optimum for three users and two files

candidates.title: Radiation-aware memory scrubbing schedule
candidates.statement: Given a time-varying radiation hazard model, an adaptive error-correction schedule attains a bounded failure probability with less energy than fixed-rate scrubbing in a restricted hardware model
candidates.consequence: Would conserve spacecraft power without obscuring memory risk
candidates.first_attack: Solve an explicit Markov upset model and compare fixed baselines

candidates.title: Crop rotation diversity stability
candidates.statement: Under a stochastic pest-soil state model, a small rotation pattern can achieve a provably lower worst-case cumulative yield loss than monoculture within the same land budget
candidates.consequence: Would quantify when rotation diversity delivers resilience
candidates.first_attack: Analyze two-crop Markov pest dynamics with explicit costs

candidates.title: Infrastructure inspection prioritization
candidates.statement: On a road network with uncertain bridge condition, a sequential inspection policy achieves bounded regret for avoided closure risk relative to an oracle
candidates.consequence: Would help allocate limited inspection capacity rationally
candidates.first_attack: Derive small Bayesian maintenance instances and regret baseline

candidates.title: Micromobility rebalancing under uncertainty
candidates.statement: For stochastic bike or scooter station demand, a bounded-capacity rebalancing policy can guarantee stockout risk below a target with fewer truck miles than static routes
candidates.consequence: Would guide lower-emission fleet operations
candidates.first_attack: Solve a small inventory-routing model with exact demand states

candidates.title: Negotiation with unverifiable utilities
candidates.statement: For a restricted bargaining game with ordinal preferences only, a robust compromise rule can bound maximum justified regret without requiring cardinal utility reports
candidates.consequence: Would reduce dependence on unverifiable interpersonal utility comparisons
candidates.first_attack: Solve three-party finite feasible-set examples

candidates.title: Long-lived storage integrity
candidates.statement: An append-only storage design can preserve publicly verifiable inclusion and non-equivocation across decades of cryptographic algorithm migrations
candidates.consequence: Could protect high-value records from algorithm obsolescence
candidates.first_attack: Specify trust transitions and adversarial rewriting model

candidates.title: Parameterized certificate sparsity
candidates.statement: Every fixed-parameter tractable graph property with bounded local witnesses admits sublinear certificates on bounded-expansion graphs
candidates.consequence: Would enable compact independently checkable decisions on large sparse networks
candidates.first_attack: Test against known kernelization lower bounds

candidates.title: Compression as a test of model equivalence
candidates.statement: For a chosen parametric model class, equality of asymptotic universal-code regret implies equivalence of selected predictive structures under explicit regularity assumptions
candidates.consequence: Would give a falsifiable link between description length and scientific structure
candidates.first_attack: Test nested exponential-family models and locate nonidentifiability

candidates.title: Coordinated recovery without central clocks
candidates.statement: An asynchronous replicated system can produce minimal recovery checkpoints with safety proved without a trusted physical clock
candidates.consequence: Could improve recovery where timing infrastructure is unreliable
candidates.first_attack: Fix crash/recovery model and prove lower bounds
